usageNotes: Returns the directory index for a specific VNet under a remote PVE node's SDN configuration, serving as a navigation endpoint to discover available sub-resources for that VNet. Because the return type is null, this endpoint is used for resource discovery rather than fetching VNet configuration data — actual VNet properties are retrieved via child endpoints. The remote and node must both be reachable from PDM at call time.

examples.summary: Inspect available sub-resources for VNet 'vnet10' on node 'pve1' of remote 'hetzner-prod'

tips: VNet names in Proxmox SDN are lowercase alphanumeric and up to 8 characters (e.g., 'vnet10', 'dmz').
This endpoint returns a directory listing (null body), not VNet config — use child paths discovered here to read actual SDN VNet details.
Open permissions ('user: all') mean any authenticated PDM token can call this; no special SDN privilege is required.
